description: Source code for Lua's internal state management, including thread state, global state, seed generation, call info management, and state initialization/closure functions.

classes.name: LX
classes.description: Structure representing thread state plus extra space, used internally for thread management.

classes.name: LG
classes.description: Structure combining thread state and global state, representing the main Lua state.

methods.name: luaE_extendCI
methods.description: Extends the CallInfo chain for a Lua thread.

methods.name: luaE_shrinkCI
methods.description: Frees half of the CallInfo structures not in use, keeping the first one.

methods.name: luaE_checkcstack
methods.description: Checks for C stack overflow and raises an error if limit exceeded.

methods.name: luaE_incCstack
methods.description: Increments C call stack count and checks for overflow.

methods.name: stack_init
methods.description: Initializes the stack for a new Lua thread.

methods.name: freestack
methods.description: Frees the stack of a Lua thread.

methods.name: init_registry
methods.description: Creates and initializes the registry table with predefined values.

methods.name: f_luaopen
methods.description: Opens parts of the Lua state that may cause memory errors.

methods.name: preinit_thread
methods.description: Preinitializes a thread with default values without allocating memory.

methods.name: close_state
methods.description: Closes and frees all resources associated with a Lua state.

methods.name: lua_newstate
methods.description: Creates a new Lua state with specified allocator.

methods.name: luaE_warnerror
methods.description: Generates a warning from an error object.
